messages:
Maya S: Quick thread to pin down the "lightweight visibility" roadmap slice for the next pilot wave. Keep scope small and customer-facing.
Harold P: Customers repeatedly ask for three priorities: per-route cost breakdown, SLO templates, and a way to link p99 regressions to model rollouts.
Jules N: From CS: Finance teams need CSVs aligned to billing windows. Security wants assurances about redaction and export controls for regulated pilots.
Asha R: Engineering constraints: raw-span ingest is the cost driver. Two practical levers: sampling policy + short exemplar retention. Prefer header-based tags to avoid touching runtime code.
Maya S: Proposed MVP (minimal, customer-impactful):
- Dashboard template: p50/p95/p99 latency, error rate, token spend trend, top routes (pre-built widgets)
- Cost export: per-route/day CSV with model_tag column, downloadable and exportable to customer S3 (signed)
- Trace tagging: single header (X-RW-TRACE: route=/v1/gen;model=rw-7b;ver=2026-07-01) parsed into structured tags
- Error analytics: group by exception signature + model_tag, show up to 3 redacted examples (retain exemplars 7 days)
Harold P: Acceptance criteria for pilots (FinRegCo and MedAI):
- CSV includes route & model_tag and matches their billing cadence
- Dashboard shows model-tag timeline and you can visually correlate a p99 spike within 24h of a rollout
- Error group opens to 3 redacted examples and offers an export-to-S3 button with consent flow
Jules N: Legal: require redaction of PII and prompt contents for regulated pilots. Exports require explicit signed export agreement. We'll supply regexes for redaction.
Asha R: Sampling policy suggestion: default = sample-on-error + adaptive reservoir sampling for routes > 40 qps. Auto-boost sampling for 30m after a model_tag rollout event. Provide per-customer override flag for pilots.
Maya S: Trade-offs to document in UI: "sampled traces" and "limited retention". Marketing will use this exact phrasing in comms.
Harold P: Dev rough timeline: template wiring (1.5 sprints), cost pipeline + CSV/S3 export (2 sprints), trace header parsing + sampling (1 sprint), error grouping + UI (1.5 sprints) => ~6 sprints. We can compress by reusing exporter infra and template widgets to ~4 sprints.
Jules N: If compressing, drop clickable raw-span drilldown from beta. Keep CSV/S3 exports and redacted examples — that's what Finance/legal care about most.
Asha R: Ops detail: enumerate model_tag values to avoid high-cardinality. Cap stored unique tags per customer (e.g., 25) and GC older tags.
Maya S: Decision proposal: ship lightweight MVP with dashboard template + per-route CSV (with model_tag) + header-based trace tags + error groups (7d examples). Stretch for pilot: raw-span drilldown and 30d exemplar retention exports.
Harold P: Action items:
- Asha: spec header format + sampling defaults (due Fri)
- Jules: legal redaction rules + export agreement draft (due Mon)
- Maya: pilot acceptance checklist + UI disclaimer copy (due Tue)
- Harold: cost pipeline changes + S3 export flow (due Mon)
ops-bot: ops: obs-canary deploy scheduled 04:00 UTC tomorrow; will alert #eng-oncall on failure.
Jules N: I'll confirm with FinRegCo/MedAI that they accept the limits if CSV/S3 export path is solid.
Maya S: Thanks team. We'll present this to CTL on Wednesday for go/no-go.
Harold P: +1
Asha R: +1
Jules N: +1 :thumbsup:
